title: Copilot Studio: interactive MCP apps render inside agent conversations
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, rendering behavior, billing statements and printed control paths are supported. Hold because the server-registration row says automation is not documented, although Microsoft documents a preview package-submission rejection API covering MCP server packages.

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified on 2026-09-02T22:56:59.
Copilot Studio agents are planned to render interactive interfaces inline when calling UI-enabled tools on compatible MCP servers.

claims.claim: No administrator switch specific to MCP app rendering is documented.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not separately stated a tenant-level default for MCP apps beyond the described maker connection behavior.
claims.quote: Searched: "MCP apps" "default" "Copilot Studio"; read roadmap record and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/mcp-apps. No separate tenant-level default is stated.
